summary: Detailed two-stage Vertical Slice master plan for Kaliyuga: The Bleeding Crown — completing and fully polishing Act I first (fluid Rudra animations, Heavy attack rebalance, Kala-Bhairava Susanoo Rage Mode, painterly Water Dragon, distinct pre-warmed MP4 biomes, 3D cel-shaded bosses, non-Hades Indian-myth visual identity HUD, complete Vaitarani Hub to Vrikodara & Ferry I redemption arc + donation showcase card), followed by Stage B (Samudra Manthan animated painting cutscene, Amaravati Heaven action Prologue with hit-reactive reverb audio, and Lord Vishnu boss duel).
